terra.problem: Jesus names God and the Son of God, but He does not name the Father in this statement.
The closing line is preachy and tautological rather than sounding like Papa Dorin.
The explanation is generic and repeats the answer without a distinct Papa Dorin voice.
The disciples' worry is stated as fact rather than marked as Papa Dorin's guess.
Jesus does not ask the disciples to come along right after saying He will wake Lazarus. Other dialogue comes before He says to go to him.
“I'll just say that once” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
